name: gradatim-editor
description: Line-by-line natural language to C code Electron editor.

scripts.dev:rust: cd rust-core && powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File build.ps1 run
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run build:rust && npm run build:icon && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.package:win: npm run build && npm run build:rust && npm run build:icon && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --win nsis
scripts.package:linux: npm run build && npm run build:rust && npm run build:icon && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --linux AppImage deb
